description_en: Remove one or more SLB server groups from a scaling group. Supported server group types include Application Load Balancer (ALB), Network Load Balancer (NLB), and Gateway Load Balancer (GWLB), which can dynamically adjust SLB policies and help improve high availability of the system
description_zh: 对于需要动态调整实例数量来应对业务变化负载以及确保应用程序的高可用性场景，调用API DetachServerGroups从伸缩组移除一个或多个负载均衡服务器组，支持的服务器组类型包括应用型负载均衡ALB、网络型负载均衡NLB和网关型负载均衡GWLB，可以实现对负载均衡策略的动态调整，并帮助提高系统的高可用性
kebab_example: aliyun ess detach-server-groups --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --scaling-group-id asg-bp18p2yfxow2dloq0000 --server-groups Type=ALB Port=22 ServerGroupId=sgp-1gv2uidn2msy0000 --api-version 2022-02-22 --region cn-hangzhou
name: DetachServerGroups

parameters.help_en: The region ID of the scaling group
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the scaling group
parameters.name: scaling_group_id

parameters.help_en:
The client token that is used to ensure the idempotence of the request.

You can use the client to generate the token, but you must make sure that the token is unique among different requests. The token can contain only ASCII characters and cannot exceed 64 characters in length. For more information, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/25965.html
parameters.help_zh:
保证请求幂等性。

从您的客户端生成一个参数值，确保不同请求间该参数值唯一。只支持ASCII字符，且不能超过64个字符。更多信息，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/25965.html
parameters.name: client_token

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to remove the existing Elastic Compute Service (ECS) instances or elastic container instances in the scaling group from the server group marked for detachment.

true
false

Default value: false
parameters.help_zh:
是否从待移除服务器组中移除当前伸缩组内的ECS实例或ECI实例。 

true：移除。

false：不移除。

默认值：false
parameters.name: force_detach

fields.help_en:
The port used by ECS instances or elastic container instances as backend servers of the server group.

For ALB and NLB types, this parameter is required. GWLB type cannot set this parameter and the default value is 6081
fields.help_zh:
服务器组中ECS实例或ECI实例使用的端口号。
ALB和NLB类型负载均衡该参数为必填参数，GWLB类型负载均衡不能设置该参数且默认值为6081
fields.name: port

fields.help_en: The ID of the server group
fields.name: server_group_id

fields.help_en:
The type of the server group. Valid values:

ALB
NLB
GWLB
fields.help_zh:
负载均衡服务器组类型。取值范围：

ALB：应用型负载均衡ALB（Application Load Balancer）。
NLB：网络型负载均衡NLB（Network Load Balancer）。
GWLB：网关型负载均衡 GWLB（Gateway Load Balancer）
fields.name: type

parameters.help_en: The information about the server groups
parameters.help_zh: 负载均衡服务器组的相关信息集合
parameters.name: server_groups

ScalingActivityId.description_en:
The ID of the scaling activity. During the scaling activity, the server group is detached from the scaling group and the existing servers, which are the ECS instances or elastic container instances in the scaling group, are removed from the server group.

This parameter is returned only if you set `ForceDetach` to `true`
ScalingActivityId.description_zh:
移出负载均衡服务器组，并移出该服务器组内的ECS实例或ECI实例时，伸缩活动的ID。
仅当`ForceDetach`取值为`true`时，返回该参数
